events = logging.getLogger("SYNTHETIC_EVENTS")
def submit(body):
    destination = events

    destination.error({"SYNTHETIC_entry": entry})

def submit(operation):

    journal.info(message)
cases.rationale: Factory log contains only a fixed server operation under the declared contract.
Both branch dictionaries contain only declared trusted server metadata.
Both branches definitely replace the sensitive container with a constant event.
Closed static helper receives only contract-trusted metadata, with keyword argument mapping.
Closed helper omits its sensitive input and returns only contract-trusted status; business return is retained.
Closed wrapper receives fixed operation and opaque server ID; mandatory event metadata is retained.
Closed static helper chain replaces the sensitive input with a constant before logging.
Caught exception is not emitted; audit logs only a fixed event and contract-trusted server result code without traceback.
Raw exception remains unlogged; explicit false disables traceback and argument is an opaque server ID.
Exception content never reaches sink; merged result is constant and operation follows server metadata contract.
Closed static helper logs only fixed failure and contract-trusted status; no exception argument or traceback is emitted.
Dynamic function dispatch invalidates the closed static helper contract; form is emitted.
Unsupported loop emits request JSON elements; synthetic contract declares them sensitive records.
Class and instance state require review; declared token is sensitive and reaches log.
External decorator and unknown transform require review; declared copy preserves raw body.
Dynamic dispatch requires review; the only value passed to the logger is a fixed marker.
Loop requires review; declared server opaque ID and fixed operation contain no identifying request content.
Instance state requires review; source visibly stores only a fixed event marker.
External decorator and transform require review; declared registration has no logging side effect and pure copy receives a constant.
